posts.content_md:
What is the best exposure to use for PFG-03C plates at 532nm? The website says 3µJ/cm² for "exposure peak sensitivity", it looks like 4mJ/cm² in the first plot below, and in the second plot it looks like -2 log(cm²/µJ) = 0.01 cm²/µJ = 100 µJ/cm²?

Am I interpreting these right? Got any advice based on actual experience?

[https://www.integraf.com/shop/pfg-03c-h ... ilm-plates](https://www.integraf.com/shop/pfg-03c-holographic-film-plates)

posts.content_md:
Found some better info on the Slavich website [https://www.slavich.com/holo_ufg-panchromatic](https://www.slavich.com/holo_ufg-panchromatic). They quote 3mJ/cm² for green and red and 2mJ/cm² for blue. Here are the correct plots.

![holo-ufg-panchromatic-fig1-3.gif](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7290)

Found some other useful info while researching this. Here is an optical density plot from this paper [https://doi.org/10.1364/AO.40.000622](https://doi.org/10.1364/AO.40.000622).

![Clipboard01.png](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7291)

This paper [http://publicaciones.eafit.edu.co/index ... 75/html_13](http://publicaciones.eafit.edu.co/index.php/ingciencia/article/view/2575/html_13) has the relative ratios for each color.

![v11n22a1f7.jpg](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7292)
